headline: Names a Brooklyn, New York Postal Service facility at 66 Meserole Avenue after former state lawmaker Joseph R. Lentol.
what_it_does: This law renames the United States Postal Service facility at 66 Meserole Avenue in Brooklyn, New York, as the Joseph R. Lentol Post Office. It changes only the name of the building and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 11, 2022, and the renaming took effect on that date.
